prerequisites: Good knowledge in thermodynamics and heat & mass transfer.

learning_outcomes.text: Advanced theoretical, methodological and analytical knowledge in the fields of heating, cooling, ventilation and air conditioning.
Diagnosis and problem solving in the fields of heating, cooling, ventilation and air conditioning.

syllabus_topics: Building heating sources and installations, distribution and other heating equipment, Heat emission devices in buildings, room ventilation.
Cooling units in buildings, air conditioning and elements, preparation and distribution of air, blowing air into a room of buildings, regulation of systems.

assessment_methods.method: Theory: from lectures and exercise problems

bibliography: Shan K Wang: Handbook of Air conditioning and refrigeration, McGraw-Hill, 2001
J. Kreider, P. Curtis, A. Rabl: Heating and cooling of Buildings, 2017
ASHRAE Pocket Guide for heating, refrigeration, ventilation, air-conditioning, 2017
ASHRAE Handbook — HVAC System and Equipment, 2024
degree: Mechanical Engineering (2nd cycle, Erasmus+ subjects, Research and Development programme)
